Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase, folks! The Aussies are out on the field. Jos Buttler and Jason Roy take the crease. Mitchell Starc is set to steam in with the new ball.
... The Run Chase ...

Right then! 126 needed for England to continue their winning momentum. A chaseable target for them but they have to keep the pace bowlers of Australia in mind as they are in hot form. Stay tuned as the chase is right on your way.

Chris Woakes says that is nice when the new ball helps the pacers early on. Adds that he didn't try to swing it much just tried to bowl it on good lengths. About Smith's catch, says that he thought that would go over him but somehow that stuck. Tells that the bowlers bowled well and it's a chaseable target.

England were absolutely brilliant with the new ball. Their pacers were making the ball move and that had the Aussies on the mat. Their spinners turned up and controlled the middle phase beautifully. Tymal Mills was a bit expensive towards but overall it was a collective performance from England's bowling compartment. Other than Mills, everyone was economical and had a good game. Chris Jordan and Chris Woakes were brilliant and shared 5 wickets among them. Here is Woakes for a chat...

Australia were caught sleeping early on as wickets were tumbling one after the other. It was their captain, Aaron Finch, who was watching from the other end and was desperate for someone to stay in the middle. Matthew Wade came in and tried to steady the ship but he too perished. Ashton Agar too went back after scoring 20 from 20 balls. Towards the end though Pat Cummins and Mitchell Starc hit a few lusty blows to take them past the 120-run mark. But still, Australia will be disappointed with their performance and now have to heavily rely on their bowlers.

England were inch-perfect right from the word go. Right from winning the toss, everything went their way. It is their bowlers who are putting on a show in this tournament and they did the same in this game. A brilliant performance and now they will fancy chasing it down pretty comfortably.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Short of a length, on middle. Mitchell Starc makes room for himself and looks to slash it over covers. He only manages to get an outside edge. Jos Buttler leans forward to take a good low catch. AUSTRALIA FINISH WITH 125!
Commentary.Howout: c Jos Buttler b Tymal Mills

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Smacked! Length ball, down the leg side. Starc pulls it way over the fine leg fence. They cross the 120-run mark now.
Josh Hazlewood is the last batter in.

OUT! RUN OUT! Length ball, outside off. Zampa looks to paddle but gets no bat on it. The ball goes to the keeper and they look to sneak in a bye. The ball is thrown by Buttler to Mills, who takes the bails off and runs Zampa out.
A run out appeal has been sent upstairs. Replay shows Adam Zampa is caught well short of the crease.
On a length, on off. Starc looks to pull but gets hit on the body. The ball rolls to the off side and they take a leg bye.
Length ball, on off. Pulled to deep mid-wicket and they get back for the second.
FOUR! Smacked! Length ball, on off. Starc smacks it to the long off fence.
Dot to end the spell. Full ball, on off. Zampa digs it to point. What a spell by Jordan. He ends with figures of 4-0-17-3!
A wide yorker now. Zampa backs away to drive but gets no bat on it.
Short ball, on the pads. Starc pulls it to deep square leg for one.
Full ball, outside off. Zampa carves it past point for one. No hat-trick for Jordan.
Adam Zampa walks out to face the hat-trick ball.

OUT! BOWLED! Six, six and out for Pat Cummins! A yorker, on off. Cummins looks to block but gets the inside edge. The ball goes onto hit the stumps and Australia lose their 8th wicket. Chris Jordan is on a hat-trick now!
Mitchell Starc walks out to bat.

OUT! TAKEN! What a catch by Jonny Bairstow! Full ball, outside off. Finch clears his front leg and looks to go over long off. He does not middle it though. Jonny Bairstow runs in, dives and takes a really good low catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Jonny Bairstow b Chris Jordan

Commentary.Commentary: Chris Jordan (3-0-15-1) to bowl out.
SIX! Oh, this is even bigger! Cummins is turning up the heat now! Length ball, on off. He heaves it deep over the square leg fence.
SIX! Smacked all the way! On a length, on off. Cummins sends the ball sailing over the long off fence. 100 up for the Aussies.
Pat Cummins is the new batsman in.

OUT! TAKEN! A really good catch and a handy knock by Agar comes to an end! Short ball, on off. He pulls it hard but the man at deep mid-wicket gets to his left and takes a very good catch. A good catch by Liam Livingstone and Ashton Agar is disappointed as he walks back to the hut.
Commentary.Howout: c Liam Livingstone b Tymal Mills

Commentary.Commentary: Full ball, on off. Finch looks to heave it but gets the inside edge back on the pads. The ball drops dead on the pitch and they take one.
On a length, around off. Agar pushes it to point for one.
Tymal Mills (2-0-18-0) is back into the attack.
Full ball, on off. Finch heaves it to long on for one.
FOUR LEG BYES! NOT OUT! Full ball, on leg. Agar gets hit on the pads and the ball rolls to the fine leg fence. But Morgan reviews this one. No bat on it but it was pitching outside leg.
England have taken a review for an LBW. UltraEdge shows no bat involved. Ball Tracker shows that the ball is pitching outside leg. England lose their review.
Length ball, on off. Pushed to the leg side for one.
A full one, on the pads. Flicked to long on for one.
SIX! High and handsome! This is good hitting by Agar! Again, in the slot and Agar whips deep over the wide long on fence.

SIX! All the way! Slower again, on a length, on off. Agar hits it towards deep square leg. Moeen Ali settles under it but crosses the ropes while taking the catch. The ball pops out of his hands and goes over the ropes.
Slower ball, on a length, down the leg side. Agar misses the swipe. Wide called.
Chris Woakes (3-0-7-2) comes back on.
Short ball, on off. Finch pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller in length, on off. Finch jams it out to point and retains the strike. 18 runs coming from the last two overs.

FOUR! Aaron Finch holds the key for Australia at the moment. This was shortish, outside off. Aaron Finch stays deep in the crease and throws the kitchen sink at it. He slashes it towards deep backward point for a boundary.
Short of a length, on middle. Ashton Agar moves on the leg side and slaps it towards covers. Eoin Morgan dives to his right and makes a half stop. Keeps it to a single.
On a length, around off. Finch steers it to deep point for another single. England won't mind these singles at all!
Short of a length, on off. Agar pulls it towards long on. Didn't get it from the middle of the bat. Only a single.
Good-length ball, on middle. Agar defends it on the off side.
Change. Chris Jordan (2-0-7-1) is back in the attack.
Well bowled! A bouncer from Mills, on middle. Aaron Finch sways away from it. A good over nonetheless for Australia. 10 runs from the over.
On the pads, Agar glances it to square leg. He rotates the strike by taking a single.
Short of a length, on middle. Finch mistimes his pull towards wide of mid on. He crosses ends.
Mills comes 'round the wicket now and bowls it on a good length, on off. Aaron Finch misses the cut. The ball zips past the outside edge.
FOUR! One brings two for Aaron Finch! Another half-volley, outside off. Aaron Finch hangs back and creams it through the covers for another boundary.
Tymal Mills is back on.

FOUR! Australia need more of these now! Fuller in length, on off. Aaron Finch lifts it straight over the bowler's head for a boundary. Tymal Mills knows it was not a good delivery and is not happy with himself.
Loopy ball, on off. Agar pushes it towards backward point.
On middle, clipped to mid-wicket for a single.
Aerial but safe! Floats it up, outside off. Ashton Agar slashes it over cover-point for one.
Tosses it up, outside off. Finch hangs back and cuts it past the diving point fielder for a single.
On middle, tucked on the leg side for a single.
Loopy ball, on middle, pushed to the bowler's left.

A dot to end! Slower through the air, on middle. Aaron Finch stays deep in the crease. He looks to work it on the leg side but inside-edges it onto the pads. A mild appeal for an lbw from Rashid but turned down.
A googly, outside off. Agar rocks back and cuts it towards covers for a run.
Outside off, Agar hangs back and cuts it to point.
Tosses it up beautifully, on middle. Agar puts a stride forward and blocks it watchfully.
Floats it up, on middle, turning back in. Agar blocks it out.
Full and on middle, Finch tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Adil Rashid (3-0-17-1) to bowl out.
Loopy ball, outside off. Agar defends it on the off side.
A full ball, outside off. Agar defends it out.
The departure of Matthew Wade will bring Ashton Agar to the crease.

OUT! TAKEN! Australia slip further down. A tossed-up ball, full and on middle. Wade skips down and looks to go downtown but mistimes it to long on where Roy takes a simple catch. Half of the Australian team is back in the shed. England on top of their game today.
Commentary.Howout: c Jason Roy b Liam Livingstone

Commentary.Commentary: Lovely fielding from Morgan! A short ball, outside off. Wade slaps it to covers where Morgan does well to stop it.
Another single as Finch tucks this full ball to mid-wicket.
Flatter and on middle. Wade flicks it to the square leg region for a single.
On a length, on off. Finch hits it to mid off. 8 coming of this over.
WIDE! A slower ball but down the leg side. Left alone.
Another short ball, outside off. Wade dabs it to third man for a single.

FOUR! Welcome boundary! A short ball from Mills, width on offer, outside off. Wade slashes it hard and the ball goes up and lands in front of the backward point fence. It is taken upstairs and the replays show that it landed just inside the ropes. Boundary.
There comes the slower ball from Mills, on a length, on middle. Wade watchfully defends it.
A full ball, on the pads. Finch flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single. They think about the second but settles with a run.
A length ball, on off. Wade taps it to covers for a quick single.

Drinks break. At the halfway mark, England have the game in their firm control and they would want to keep it like this to restrict the Aussies to a low score. For Australia, this pair holds the key and both would want to bat till the end of the innings. Tymal Mills comes in the attack now.
Single to end the over! A loopy ball, outside off. Wade skips down and knocks it to deep cover for a single.
Darted on the pads, nudged to the leg side for a single.
Flatter again, on a length, on middle. Finch tucks it to the right of the bowler and Livingstone cuts it off.
A flatter ball, angling on middle. Wade punches off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
Slightly short, on middle, pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full ball, on middle. Finch solidly blocks it out.
Tossed up, on off. Finch works it to deep covers and retains the strike. A much-needed partnership building for the Aussies.
Appeal for LBW but not given! A full ball, angling down, on the pads. Finch looks to slog sweep it but misses and gets hit on the pads. Might be pitching outside leg.
Googly now, full and on off. Wade reads it and pushes it to deep cover for a single.
Short and on off. Wade slaps it to deep cover and collects a brace.
Full and on middle. Wade reverse-sweeps it but finds backward point.
Catch it is the call but falls short of wide long off. A full ball, outside off. Finch lifts it towards wide long off for a single.
Wade comes down the track so Liam Livingstone darts it on the pads. It is pushed to the left of the bowler but the big Liam Livingstone dives there and stops it. Just 5 from the over then.
Darted on the pads. Finch works it past square leg for one.
Shorter ball, around off. Finch punches it but the man at short cover dives and stops it.
Short and wide outside off. Finch slaps it wide of sweeper cover. The batters sprint back for the second.
Tossed up, on off. Wade pushes it to long on for one.
Shorter ball, outside off. Finch cuts it past point for one.
Spin from both ends now. Liam Livingstone is into the attack.
Nicely tossed up, on off. Wade blocks it out.

FOUR! A much-needed boundary for the Aussies! Flatter ball, outside off. Wade rocks back to cut but gets the outside edge. The man at first slip dives but cannot stop it. The man at short third man has no chance too and the ball reaches the fence.
Loopy ball, outside off. Finch drives it past covers for one.
Tossed up, outside off. Wade drives it to the right of long off. Roy cuts it off and keeps it to one.
Loopy ball, around off. Blocked out.
Matthew Wade walks out to the middle.

OUT! LBW! Name a better duo than Adil Rashid and his googly! It can get Kohli out. It can get Russell out and it gets Stoinis out here! This is a touch shorter and lands outside off. It turns back in sharply and Marcus Stoinis looks to cut. He gets pinged on the pads and the umpire takes no time in raising his finger. That looked dead straight and is not reviewed by Marcus Stoinis.
Adil Rashid is back into the attack. Went for 6 runs in his first over.
Dot to end the Powerplay and the Englishmen are right on top of this game. Length ball, on off. Finch takes a step down the track and works it to mid on. Australia are reeling at 21 for 3.
A touch fuller, around off. Finch drives it nicely but straight towards mid on. Dot again.
Right on the good length, outside off. Finch presses forward and drives it nicely to mid off.
Fuller ball, around off. Finch looks to flick it but gets the leading edge to covers.
Length ball, on the pads. Stoinis looks to flick but gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls to square leg and a leg bye is taken.
Woakes slips this down the leg side. Stoinis misses the flick and it is called a wide.
Short of a length, around off. The big Marcus Stoinis blocks it out.
Drifting on the pads, on a length. Finch clips it wide of deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Just short of a length, on the fourth stump. Finch pushes it to covers.
Again, on a length, just outside off. Finch is solid in his defence.
On a length, around off. Finch plays it with his bat and pads together. That brings out an appeal by Jordan for LBW but the umpire is unmoved.
Length ball, on the pads. Finch flicks it away past mid-wicket for a couple of runs.

NOT OUT! Umpire's call it is! On a length, lands on off and comes back in. Finch looks to block but gets hit on the pads. The appeal is made but the umpire is not convinced. But Morgan is not convinced with the umpire's decision and takes the review. No bat on that one and umpire's call on wickets hitting saves Finch.
Review time! Now England take a review for LBW. UltraEdge shows no bat involved. Ball Tracker shows umpire's call on wickets hitting and the on-field decision stays. England retain their review.
Good-length outside off, shaping away from the batter, at 138 kph. Marcus Stoinis leaves it alone. Sensational stuff from Chris Woakes! A wicket and four runs from the over.
Marcus Stoinis walks out now.
Review time! Glenn Maxwell refers it upstairs after been given LBW. UltraEdge shows no bat. Ball Tracker shows three reds and the on-field decision stays. Australia lose their review.

OUT! LBW! Chris Woakes you beauty! Cannot keep him out of the game, can you? Good-length ball, slanting on middle and leg. Glenn Maxwell looks to slog but misses. He gets thudded on the front pad. Chris Woakes appeals for an LBW and the umpire raises his finger without any hesitation. Glenn Maxwell opts for a review after discussing with Aaron Finch. UltraEdge shows no bat involved. Ball Tracker shows three reds. Glenn Maxwell has to walk back to the pavilion. England right on top!
On a length on off, Maxwell turns it through mid-wicket. He pushes hard for the second run and gets it comfortably.
Good-length ball, on middle, at 141 clicks. Glenn Maxwell nudges it to mid on.
Short of a length, on off. Glenn Maxwell on his toes pushes it to mid on.
Fuller in length, on off, at 137 kph. Glenn Maxwell clips it to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Good-length ball, on middle. Glenn Maxwell works it to deep square leg for a single.
On a length, around off. Maxwell blocks it out.
On a length, around off. Finch looks to block but gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls away and they cross over. It is given as runs, so maybe there was some bat on it.
Back of a length, around off. Maxwell flicks it away. Gets off the mark with a single.
Beaten! Nice swing there. Fuller ball, lands on off and shapes away. Maxwell looks to drive it down the ground but gets no bat on it.
Glenn Maxwell is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Chris Jordan bags a wicket off his first ball! Short of a length, outside off. Steven Smith shuffles across and looks to pull it away. He gets it from the toe end of the bat though. The ball goes towards mid on. Chris Woakes backpedals, leaps and takes it with his right hand. He tumbles over as well but holds onto the catch. A super catch to end Steven Smith's innings. Australia have been put under the pump early!
Commentary.Howout: c Chris Woakes b Chris Jordan

Commentary.Commentary: Chris Jordan is into the attack.
Fuller in length, on middle and leg. Steven Smith opens his account by working it to backward square for one. Brilliant over from Chris Woakes. A wicket and 2 runs from it.

Half-hearted appeal for lbw, not given! Length delivery, angling in, on leg. Steven Smith shuffles across and looks to flick but misses. Gets hit on the pads and the ball goes on the leg side. The review is not taken. Maybe, it was heading down the leg side.
Length ball, outside off with a hint of late away movement. Steven Smith shoulders arms to this one.
Good-length ball, around off. Steven Smith shuffles across and looks to defend. He misses and the ball zips past his outside edge.
Steven Smith walks out at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Chris Woakes draws first blood and it's the big fish, David Warner. Brilliant start for England. Woakes bowls it on a good length, on off. David Warner prods and looks to guide it towards the off side. The ball goes off the outside edge and carries through to the keeper. Jos Buttler behind the stumps makes no mistake. The corridor of uncertainty that Chris Woakes loves so much does the trick again. David Warner is livid with himself and has to walk back to the pavilion for a timid score.
Commentary.Howout: c Jos Buttler b Chris Woakes

Commentary.Commentary: Good-length ball, on off, at 121 kph. Aaron Finch tucks it to mid on for a single.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is Chris Woakes.
A single to end the over! Rashid tosses it up, on middle. Finch tucks it to mid-wicket. 6 runs from the first over. A decent start for Australia.
FOUR! First boundary off the innings! Flighted delivery, full and on leg. Aaron Finch clears his front leg and lifts it over mid off. The ball races away to the boundary.
Three dots in a row! Aaron Finch makes room for himself by moving to the leg side. Rashid bowls it flatter on leg. Finch cuts it off the back foot straight towards the cover-point fielder.
Tosses it up, outside off. Aaron Finch charges down the track and then offers his pads to it.
Floats it up, on off. Aaron Finch puts a stride forward and blocks it out.

Rashid starts with a tossed-up delivery, on middle. David Warner covers his stumps and pushes it back to the bowler. The ball goes through Adil Rashid's hands to mid on. A single taken. Australia and David Warner are underway.

We are done with the pre-match formalities. Eoin Morgan leads his team out on the field. Aaron Finch and David Warner walk out to bat for Australia. It will be Adil Rashid to start with the ball. Before the game starts, both the teams take the knee to support the Black Lives Matter movement. Here we go...
We are set for the clash! But first, both the teams walk out for the national anthems. First, the anthem of Great Britain will be played followed by Australia's.

David Warner is down for a chat. He says that it was great to spend some time in the middle against Sri Lanka and to get a good start at the top. Adds that England are a top team and they are looking forward to the clash. Mentions that leading to the World Cup, they were not considered the favorites as they haven't had a great time in the competition historically.

Aaron Finch, the skipper of Australia, says that they would have bowled first as well. Mentions that the trend here is to bat second but they will try to put up a good score as the pitch looks good. Informs that there is one change as Ashton Agar comes in for Mitchell Marsh. Tells that David Warner is and has been a great player for 10 years.

Eoin Morgan, the England skipper, says that there is a bit of grass on the wicket so it will be a good wicket to bat on. Adds that dew might come in so they will chase. Informs that Mark Wood is still not 100% and they have no changes in the side. Says that only time will tell if Moeen Ali will bowl in the Powerplay.

Australia (Playing XI) - Aaron Finch (C), David Warner, Glenn Maxwell, Steven Smith, Marcus Stoinis, Matthew Wade (WK), Pat Cummins, Mitchell Starc, Ashton Agar (In for Mitchell Marsh), Adam Zampa, Josh Hazlewood.
England (Unchanged playing XI) - Jos Buttler (WK), Jason Roy, Dawid Malan, Eoin Morgan (C), Jonny Bairstow, Liam Livingstone, Moeen Ali, Chris Woakes, Chris Jordan, Adil Rashid, Tymal Mills.
TOSS - Time for the coin toss. Both the skippers are out in the middle. Up goes the coin and lands in favor of England. They will bowl first!

If England are the most complete side of the tournament, Australia are not far behind. They had to stretch the game deep to get their win against the Proteas but they convincingly defeated Sri Lanka. The pressure from the middle order too will be alleviated as David Warner regained his mojo at the right time, playing a match-winning knock against Sri Lanka while Aaron Finch too seems to be getting into his groove. Neither team will get knocked out if they were to lose but the prospect of topping the points table is too enticing to ignore. The Aussies will look to bring their 'A' game to hand a defeat to England. Considering the weight this rivalry has enjoyed over the years, a nutcracker of a game is on the cards. Stay tuned for further updates.

England have had a splendid run in this high-profile tournament so far. They won 2 straight matches against West Indies and Bangladesh respectively. Their bowlers have picked up 19 wickets in total which shows their effort with the ball. Batting wise, they have not been chasing down a big total yet because, in both the games they played, they bowled first. Jason Roy though showed his class in the match against Bangladesh. If at all, they bat first in this match, it is the perfect opportunity for their batters to display a performance to remember. The form of Malan, Morgan and Livingstone might be a concern but what each brings to the fore, England will not worry about it too much.

Hello and a warm welcome to Match number 26 of the T20 World Cup. Things are heating up in the tournament and in this encounter two of the world cricket's biggest powerhouses, England and Australia will go against each other. Which side will get their third win on the trot and top the table? We shall find out soon.
... MATCH DAY ...
